Acting.definition: Performing the duties of a specific post temporarily when the post holder is absent.

All rights reserved.definition: A statement meaning the rights holder has retained their rights; you are not allowed to use the work without their permission.

Approve.definition: To grant official permission or agree to something.

Authorisation.definition: Official permission that enables you to do something.

Book.definition: A collection of bound pages containing text or images.

Certificate.definition: An official document that shows proof of something, such as qualification or permission.

Certification.definition: Official confirmation that something has been examined and approved.

Commissioner.definition: A senior official who leads or oversees a department or a specific area.

Date.definition: A specific day on the calendar.

Dog.definition: A domesticated animal often kept at home; can be a guard or a friend.

Duplicate.definition: To make multiple copies of the same thing.

Edition.definition: A specific version of a book published at a particular time, for example, the first edition.

Education.definition: Knowledge and skills people acquire through learning.

Email.definition: An electronic message sent over the internet to a user's specific address.

Extra.definition: Addition; something extra that is not required.

Fax.definition: A method of sending a copy of a paper document using a special communications machine (fax).

Friendship.definition: A positive relationship of mutual love and support between people or other beings.

Human being.definition: An intelligent being with the ability to think who lives in society.

ISBN.definition: A unique international number that identifies a book.

Institution.definition: An organisation established for a specific purpose, e.g., education or research.

Jackal.definition: A small, cunning wild animal; it eats small animals or scraps.

Ministry.definition: The main government department that oversees a specific area, such as education.

Month.definition: A period of approximately 30 days in a year; also the names of the months.

Not permitted.definition: It is not acceptable to do; it has been prohibited by the authority.

P.O. Box (Post Office Box).definition: A post office box used to receive letters and parcels.

Phone.definition: A device used to make and receive voice calls or messages.

Pre-primary Education.definition: Education for young children before starting Standard One.

Print.definition: To produce text or images on paper or another medium using a printing machine.

Project.definition: An organised undertaking with a specific objective and an implementation timeframe.

Publication.definition: A written work that has been published, such as a book or booklet.

Publisher.definition: A person or organisation that publishes books or other publications.

Republic.definition: A form of government in which citizens elect their leaders.

Science.definition: A method of understanding the world through observation and experimentation.

Technology.definition: The use of knowledge and tools to solve problems or make work easier.

To copy.definition: To write or take words/work exactly as they are from another source.

Translate.definition: Changing words from one language to another.

Union.definition: The uniting of two or more things or areas into one.

Website.definition: An online location that contains information; you access it via its address in a browser.

Writer.definition: A person who writes texts such as books or stories.

about.definition: A word that indicates the topic of something; it shows that something concerns a particular thing.

after.definition: The time that follows another event.

agreement.definition: A mutual decision accepted by two or more parties.

also.definition: A word used to indicate the addition of another thing; likewise.

and him/her.definition: "And him/her"; indicates that the person is also included in the event or group.

animal.definition: A living creature such as a dog, cat, chicken, or elephant.

animals.definition: Creatures such as cattle, goats, birds, etc.; not humans or plants.

answer.definition: To say or write information in response to a question.

arrive.definition: To arrive at a certain place.

ask.definition: To seek to know by asking a question.

big.definition: Of large size or degree; not small.

blow.definition: The rapid movement of wind, often producing sound.

burn.definition: To emit heat or light; to be in a state of burning.

burn; roast; grill; pierce.definition: To burn or cook over a fire; sometimes to pierce with a pointed object.
variations: to burn; to roast; to grill; to pierce

but.definition: A conjunction that indicates a contrast or the opposite of the preceding idea.

cassava.definition: An edible root grown in fields and eaten after being cooked or dried.

chase.definition: To run after someone in order to catch them; to make someone else run.

chase away.definition: To remove a person or animal by force or by chasing them off.

child.definition: A young person who is growing; often a pre-primary or primary school pupil.

club.definition: A heavy wooden stick with a knobbed head, used as a weapon or for self-defence.

cooperate.definition: To do something together with others; to help one another in order to accomplish a goal or task.

crops.definition: Things obtained from farming, such as maize or cassava.

day.definition: A 24-hour period consisting of day and night.

dog.definition: A domesticated animal; it guards, plays, and is a friend to humans.

eat.definition: To put food into the mouth, chew, and swallow; 'to be eaten' is to receive that action (passive).

environment.definition: All the things that surround us, such as air, water, trees, soil, and living organisms.

explain.definition: Provide explanations so that others can understand clearly.

extinguish.definition: To extinguish a fire or light so that it does not continue to burn or shine.

farm.definition: A piece of land where people grow crops for food or for commercial purposes.

fire.definition: Something that burns and gives off heat and light.

fox.definition: A wild animal of the dog family; small and with a bushy tail.

harsh.definition: Very strong or producing a large effect; it can hurt.

home.definition: The place where you live; in the house.

human being.definition: A person; an intelligent being capable of thinking and speaking.

in the wild.definition: An area in the wild, far from human settlements.

incinerate.definition: To burn or completely destroy by fire until nothing remains.

kindle a fire.definition: To place and arrange firewood, etc., so that a fire starts burning; to light a fire.

list.definition: To say or write the names of items in succession.

maize.definition: A cereal grown and eaten as food; its kernels are yellow or white.

now.definition: At this time; at the present time or right now.

on the farm.definition: A place for cultivation; on a farm.

once upon a time.definition: Words used to begin a story; they mean a long time ago.

picture.definition: A drawing or image that shows an object, a person, or an animal.

protect.definition: To keep safe; to take care of so that it is not affected or harmed.

run towards.definition: To run towards a particular place.

sadness.definition: A feeling of sadness or of feeling bad.

second.definition: The 2nd in order; follows the first.

so that.definition: A word that indicates purpose or reason for doing something (for the sake of).

source.definition: The origin or cause of something.

starting from.definition: To start from a particular time or place.

struggle.definition: To keep oneself very busy trying to do something, often restlessly or without success.

succeed.definition: To achieve good results in what you set out to do.

take.definition: To lift or carry something from one place to another.

teacher.definition: A person who teaches and guides students in school.

three.definition: Number 3; the quantity that comes after two.

timidity.definition: A state of feeling weak, ashamed, or lacking courage.

to act.definition: To perform or portray through actions as if it were a real event.

to agree.definition: To say yes or consent to a proposal or plan.

to be consumed by fire.definition: To burn completely in a fire until it is gone.
variations: they have been consumed by fire
it has been consumed by fire

to be happy.definition: To feel good and joyful; to be happy.

to be saddened.definition: To feel sadness or sorrow about a bad thing that has happened.

to be surprised.definition: To feel surprise at something you did not expect.

to chase away.definition: To chase a person or animal away.

to continue.definition: To move forward or do something without stopping.

to damage.definition: To make something bad or unable to work.

to draw.definition: To make a drawing with a pen, pencil, or paint on paper.

to go.definition: To move or travel towards a place.

to guide.definition: To show the way or guide people to do something well and safely.

to inspect.definition: To look carefully to determine the condition or quality of something.

to live.definition: To be alive or to live/stay in a place. Example: waliishi = they continued to live/stay.

to plant.definition: To put seeds or seedlings in the soil so they grow.

to rear animals.definition: To care for and rear animals at home or on the farm.

to return.definition: To go back to where you came from.

to roast.definition: To cook or burn with fire, often over charcoal or open flames.

to see.definition: To look with the eyes; to discover something by sight.

to speak.definition: To utter words aloud; to talk.

to take care of.definition: To look after and protect something so it does not get damaged; to keep it safe.

together.definition: To be with others; not alone.

turn.definition: The period for each person to do work or a duty in sequence (e.g., working in shifts).

why.definition: A question that asks for a reason.

wilderness.definition: A large area with trees or grass without human settlements.

wind.definition: Air that moves from one place to another.

work.definition: An activity you do to fulfil duties or earn income. The expression 'to work' means to perform an activity.
